items.title: Ed Allen Interview, 1961-01-14
items.q: Was Ellington popular then, at that time?

ctx.x: Yeah, I wouldn't say the best known band, but it was one of the best known spots in town. Better raise your prestige when you worked at Connies Inn at that time. The Connies Inn Cotton Club up in Harlem, that was the Top Night Club. People come all over the world, they come here, Connies Inn and the Cotton Club. And that was in, what year, that was 27, 28, then the Top Night Club.
Was Ellington popular then, at that time?

It was just beginning. I guess Fletcher Henderson was more popular. Yeah, Fletcher Henderson was a band, he was like a rose band. Even before the Cotton Club got popular with the main bands they had in there. Did you ever play with Fletcher Henderson? No, I never had. I played some of his rings, but he used to play some of his rings down there and cut it in for us to play. I never played with him.
